test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six colleagues, Ranjana, Diksha, Chahat, Aakash, Rita and Suraj, are sitting on a bench in a park facing north. Rita is sitting at the east end of the bench. Ranjana and Chahat were sitting immediately next to each other. There are only two people sitting between Aakash and Suraj. Diksha has only one person to her right. Aakash is sitting at the west end of the bench. There are three people between Rita and Ranjana. Who is third from the west end of the bench?
solution:
**Explanation:**

Number of colleagues = 6 namely, Ranjana, Diksha, Chahat, Aakash, Rita and Suraj.

All are facing North direction.

**Rita is sitting at the east end of the bench.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac1d40dfeece3a46e93bf896e740649009703f282208a4283a53ac2a05857d8d.png] ​**

**There are three people between Rita and Ranjana.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/907adecf1c513d18361e8d3e86935befae4fb08add5aff2f425ed684881293f4.png] ​**

**Aakash is sitting at the west end of the bench.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3279d11d38f84ace4c84d2ba91afbd4d592cd5697965637af7c577b5f818558f.png] ​**

**Diksha has only one person to her right.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3279d11d38f84ace4c84d2ba91afbd4d592cd5697965637af7c577b5f818558f.png] 

There are only two people sitting between Aakash and Suraj.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f670d30afded68751c74dc61da26f98794fb18c02fde16295f5ed94b7244f882.png] ​

Ranjana and Chahat were sitting immediately next to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19a35ccd1bb5608ee156a2b43c3cb0b1f2f2864ed43ca9896d7dfaceee82cfa0.png] **​**

**Chahat is third from the west end of the bench.**

**​**Hence,** Chahat **is the **correct answer.**
